title: Test VAT penny amounts and receivable date boundaries
public_pr_body:
Adds 16 regression cases for exact signed pennies, 20% VAT on odd penny amounts, zero/negative collectible balances, refunds and overdue calendar dates across month/year ends, leap day and both UK clock changes. No calculation rules or application code changed.

Focused tests: 16 passed. Full suite, TypeScript and ESLint are running; totals will be recorded on codex/work-ownership. No docs/ files, migrations, Ready label or deployment.
